lazytrae.note: LazyTrae hooks configuration. Five configured Trae events invoke eight local scripts: SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, PreToolUse, PostToolUse, and Stop. PostCompact is handled through SessionStart recovery detection and UserPromptSubmit context-pressure markers.
lazytrae.safety: All hooks exit 0 always. They never block Trae operations. No network calls — pure local file I/O.
lazytrae.postcompact_gap: Trae has no PostCompact event. LazyTrae uses SessionStart to detect post_compact_recovery_needed and UserPromptSubmit to detect context-pressure markers.
